description: This file is a shell script implementing a service for configuration restoration via USB device. It handles mounting, checking for specific files, and executing commands to restore factory defaults or configuration based on the presence of certain files on a USB device.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Initializes the service, logs start status, handles USB device check.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service, logs stop status.

methods.name: service_usb_insert
methods.description: Handles actions when a USB device is inserted, checks for specific files for factory reset or configuration restore.

methods.name: service_usb_remove
methods.description: Handles actions when a USB device is removed (currently a no-op).

methods.name: service_usb_device_state
methods.description: Checks current USB device state and calls insert or remove handling functions accordingly.
